changes.to: Maker release (2026-09-16): wheeled dual-arm semi-humanoid, up to 4 kg per arm and 10 kg with both, 6 h continuous operation, NVIDIA Jetson Thor on board, 100 Hz arm control, mecanum base, cameras in head and hands, bilateral and VR teleoperation for data collection, designed and built in Japan with mass production planned for 2027. The 126-162 cm extended height, ~100 kg and 22 DoF in reseller sheets come from the maker's distributed spec sheet and are not on the release, so they are left out here.

ugo's domestically designed and built semi-humanoid (wheeled dual-arm) for factory work and physical-AI data collection, with ugo's autonomous navigation stack and teleoperation-based data capture; mass production planned for 2027.
